name: Database Migration Baseline
description: Captures business context, constraints, governance and acceptance criteria needed to plan a database migration.

sections.title: Business Context
sections.description: Understand the business drivers, timing, stakeholders and commercial constraints.

questions.text: What is the primary business driver for this migration?
Who is the primary business owner or sponsor?
Describe the scope of this engagement in your own words.
Is there a fixed migration deadline or business event driving the schedule?
questions.helpText: Include the date, event, contractual commitment or end-of-support milestone.

questions.text: Which budget or commercial constraints could affect the migration approach or target selection?

sections.title: Availability & Risk
sections.description: Define downtime tolerance, recovery objectives and operational timing constraints.

questions.text: What is the maximum tolerable downtime during cutover? (hours)
What is the Recovery Time Objective (RTO)?
What is the Recovery Point Objective (RPO)?
Are there blackout periods when migration is not permitted?
Describe blackout periods, peak events or other timing restrictions.
What annual data growth and planning horizon must the target support?
questions.helpText: Provide an estimated annual growth rate or volume and the number of years to size for.

sections.title: Compliance, Security & Data Governance
sections.description: Capture regulatory, data handling, retention and test-data requirements.

questions.text: Which compliance frameworks apply?
Which data classifications are present in the migration scope?
Is data residency or sovereignty a requirement?
Are there restrictions on data leaving the current environment?
Describe retention, deletion, archival or legal-hold requirements that the target must preserve.
What production-like test-data and masking requirements apply to migration rehearsals?
Describe any specific security or audit requirements.

sections.title: Target Platform & Connectivity
sections.description: Record target preferences, operating model and infrastructure readiness.

questions.text: What is the preferred target platform?
options: SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines

questions.text: Is the target platform already provisioned?
Is a hybrid or phased migration acceptable?
Are there preferred Azure regions?
Who owns source-to-target network, firewall, DNS and private-connectivity approvals?
What target operating model is expected?

sections.title: Technical Constraints
sections.description: Confirm application coupling, dependencies and remediation ownership.

questions.text: Are there applications tightly coupled to the database that must be migrated together?
List known application or integration dependencies and their owners.
Which discovered database-specific features are business-critical, removable or require remediation?
questions.helpText: Identify the feature, disposition and remediation owner rather than repeating facts collected by the assessment agent.

questions.text: Is there an existing DBA team who will support the migration?

sections.title: Acceptance & Lifecycle
sections.description: Define approval authority, coexistence and source retirement expectations.

questions.text: Who can accept data reconciliation, application behavior, performance, security and operational readiness?
Is a source and target coexistence period required after cutover?
What criteria and approvals are required to decommission the source and terminate related licenses or contracts?
